headlines.description: — David Pastrnak scored 15 seconds into overtime and the Boston Bruins beat the Nashville Predators 3-2 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pastrnak lifts Bruins to 3-2 win over Predators with OT goal

events.name: Buffalo Sabres at Toronto Maple Leafs

headlines.description: — Rasmus Dahlin had the first hat trick of his NHL career to go along with two assists and the Buffalo Sabres beat the Toronto Maple Leafs 7-4 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dahlin scores first NHL hat trick to lead Sabres to 7-4 win over Maple Leafs

events.name: Vegas Golden Knights at Montreal Canadiens

headlines.description: — Jake Evans scored at 3:58 of overtime, leading the Montreal Canadiens to a 3-2 victory over the Vegas Golden Knights on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jake Evans scores in overtime to lift Canadiens past Golden Knights 3-2

events.name: Los Angeles Kings at Detroit Red Wings

headlines.description: — Anton Forsberg made 26 saves and the Los Angeles Kings beat the Red Wings 3-1 on Tuesday night as Detroit winger Patrick Kane moved into a tie...
headlines.shortLinkText: Detroit's Patrick Kane ties Modano for American-born NHL points mark in 3-1 loss to Kings

headlines.description: — Mikhail Sergachev scored in the third period to put Utah ahead to stay, and the Mammoth held on for a 4-3 win over the Florida Panthers on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sergachev's goal helps lift Utah Mammoth to 4-3 win over Florida Panthers

events.name: Winnipeg Jets at New Jersey Devils

headlines.description: — Mark Scheifele scored his 26th goal of the season, reigning MVP Connor Hellebuyck stopped 26 of the 29 shots he faced and the Winnipeg Jets ended their two-game skid by beating the New Jersey Devils 4-3 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mark Scheifele scores his 26th goal as the Jets hold on to beat the Devils 4-3

events.name: Dallas Stars at St. Louis Blues

headlines.description: — Thomas Harley’s goal with just over a minute left short-circuited a late rally by the St. Louis Blues and lifted the Dallas Stars to a 4-3 win on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Harley's late goal lifts Stars past Blues, 4-3

headlines.description: — Kirill Kaprizov scored the shootout winner as the Minnesota Wild defeated the Chicago Blackhawks 4-3 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kaprizov's shootout goal gives Wild 4-3 victory over Blackhawks

events.name: San Jose Sharks at Vancouver Canucks

headlines.description: — Macklin Celebrini had a goal and three assists, the San Jose Sharks scored three first-period goals in a span of 4:04, and went on to beat the Vancouver Canucks 5-2 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Celebrini's 4 points lead Sharks to 5-2 win over Canucks

headlines.description: — Jared McCann had two goals and two assists as the Seattle Kraken beat the Washington Capitals 5-1 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: McCann has 2 goals and 2 assists to lead the Kraken to a 5-1 win over the Capitals
